no.0: You sure? You're just going to be boring this year?

yes.0: As the keeper of all things amazing around these parts, I have a #i2430658# #r#t2430658##k for you! But handing gifts over to people is SO last year, so I gave it to a monster to keep!
yes.1: Hope you like hunting!\n\nI'll give you one hint. It isn't with any #bmonsters more than 10 levels below you or 20 levels above you#k, so don't even bother with them!
